draft.emotion: a slightly burdened or responsible tone, typical of daily obligations
notes: Always plural when referring to school assignments, though English 'homework' is uncountable.
Commonly used with the verb 'hacer' ('hacer los deberes': to do one's homework). In Latin America, 'la tarea' is more common.

senses.definition: School work that a student is given to do at home.
